usedFor: Copy.ai finishes the writing, and Webflow publishes it when “Completed Workflow Run” feeds “Create Item” into a collection.

bestTemplate.name: “Completed Workflow Run” in Copy.ai, then “Create Item” in Webflow
bestTemplate.why: Finished copy lands in your Webflow collection as a new item, ready for review before it goes live.

watchOut: “Create Live Item” publishes the site immediately, so choose “Create Item” unless you want that.
